liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Listener describes the opener as plaintive but crushing [17]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Listener describes the performance as unique [16]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Listener characterizes the rendition as superb [16]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Listener praises Phil's stellar solos in this track [17]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Listener identifies the Wharf Rat and Truckin' as sloppy [20]
- **That's All Right, Mama** (1 review): Jerry's first two lead breaks display sheer dominance [20]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Listener asks if a Fire On The Mountain tease is audible [27]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Listener notes sparse and beautiful licks in this song [20]
- Listener describes the version as wonderful, upbeat, and enthusiastic [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.89640.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 274 min; rated 4.85/5 by 20 [1]
- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.fix-89640.89730.flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 275 min; rated 4.92/5 by 12 [2]
- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.tobin.patched-89730.90979.flac16**: soundboard; 31 songs; 283 min; rated 4.54/5 by 13 [3]
- **gd73-06-10.sbd.hollister.174.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 264 min; rated 4.49/5 by 218 [10]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the recording as surreal and dreamy; Listener notes great sound quality, potentially suitable for a Dick's Pick; Levels are low; mixing improves around the seventh song [18][23][24][26]

## Around the show

- Duane Allman was deceased before this performance took place [16]
- Dickey Betts joined the band, dueling with Garcia [17]
- Allman Brothers Band members were listening backstage during the show [19]
- The third set featured the Allman Brothers Band [26]
- Set 3 included Merl Saunders, Dickey Betts, and Butch Trucks [1]
- Wet Willie and the Allman Brothers Band opened the show [4]
- Listener prefers this show over the May 26 Kezar performance [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.89640.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Source is FOB unknown mics to master cassette to reel [1]
- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.fix-89640.89730.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D [2]. Also: Source is FOB unknown mics to master cassette to reel [2]
- **gd1973-06-10.sbd.miller.tobin.patched-89730.90979.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Kevin Tobin; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD [3]. Also: Miller SBD patched with two audience sources and pitch corrected [3]
- **gd73-06-10.sbd.hollister.174.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister and G.S. Hamilton; source: Soundboard [10]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 10, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/june-10-1973) [29]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Robert F. Kennedy Stadium - June 10, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/june-10-1973) [30]
